text:
Niamh Corrigan captained the yacht Seren Aduial to victory in the Pallister Cup, finishing the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours and 47 minutes.

The final race was held on 14 September 2023 off the coast of Veldmoor Bay. Seren Aduial placed first among 18 entries.

Tobias Wrenfield, Chief Race Officer of the Pallister Cup Committee, confirmed Corrigan as skipper at the post-race briefing.

The report rests on the official Pallister Cup Crew Declaration Form, which was filed with the Veldmoor Sailing Authority on 11 September 2023, three days before the race.

**What it means for the sector:** A win in a field of 18 over a course of this length strengthens the profile of Seren Aduial and its crew. Sponsors and charter operators tend to watch results like this closely. The clear paper trail, from declaration form to committee confirmation, also shows the event's record-keeping is in order.
